environment.description: Kubernetes pod with custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-inventory-svc' loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/app=localhost/k8s-inventory-svc. Profile compiled from /etc/apparmor.d/k8s-inventory-svc with explicit deny rules. Process runs as non-root (UID 1001) with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and allowPrivilegeEscalation=false. Additionally, a SELinux MCS label (s0:c12,c45) is applied via seLinuxOptions in the pod securityContext restricting file access to matching labeled objects only.

config.apparmor_rules: profile k8s-inventory-svc flags=(attach_disconnected) { #include <abstractions/base> /app/data/** r, /app/cache/** rw, /app/logs/** r, /usr/local/lib/python3.11/** r, /usr/local/bin/python3.11 ix, deny /etc/** rwklx, deny /proc/** rw, deny /sys/** rw, deny /root/** rwklx, deny /home/** rwklx, deny /var/** rwklx, deny /tmp/** rwklx, }
